<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.PresteyTaylorEtpModel: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Calculates the potential evapotranspiration with the Priestley-Taylor method, from time series of net radiation, air temperature and atmospheric pressure, at hourly or daily time steps. Missing values are replaced by the default values.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Evapotranspiration, Priestley-Taylor, Hydrologic<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.PresteyTaylorEtpModel`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inNetradiation` | CSV file | W/m² |  | The net radiation, as the mean of the time step. |
| `defaultDailyNetradiation` | double | W/m² | `300.0` | The net radiation used where it is missing, with daily time steps. |
| `defaultHourlyNetradiation` | double | W/m² | `100.0` | The net radiation used where it is missing, with hourly time steps. |
| `doHourly` | boolean |  | `false` | Use hourly time steps; if not set, the time steps are daily. |
| `fDataID` | String |  |  | The id of the data columns, common to all the time series. |
| `inTemp` | CSV file | °C |  | The air temperature, as the mean of the time step. |
| `pAlpha` | double |  | `0` | The Priestley-Taylor coefficient: 1.26 for well-watered surfaces. With 0, the evapotranspiration is 0. |
| `pGmorn` | double |  | `0` | The soil heat flux, as a fraction of the net radiation, during the day (from 7:00 to 17:00). Used only with hourly time steps. |
| `pGnight` | double |  | `0` | The soil heat flux, as a fraction of the net radiation, during the night. Used only with hourly time steps. |
| `defaultTemp` | double | °C | `15.0` | The air temperature used where it is missing. |
| `inPressure` | CSV file | kPa |  | The atmospheric pressure, as the mean of the time step. |
| `defaultPressure` | double | kPa | `101.3` | The atmospheric pressure used where it is missing. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outPTEtp` | output file | mm | The potential evapotranspiration of each time step. |

**References**

- Priestley, C. H. B., Taylor, R. J. (1972). On the assessment of surface heat flux and evaporation using large-scale parameters. Monthly Weather Review, 100(2), 81-92.
- Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56. FAO, Rome.
